Title: Magic Mike
Body (HTML): Mike, an experienced stripper, takes a younger performer called The Kid under his wing and schools him in the arts of partying, picking up women, and making easy money.

Title: Lincoln
Body (HTML): The revealing story of the 16th US President's tumultuous final months in office. In a nation divided by war and the strong winds of change, Lincoln pursues a course of action designed to end the war, unite the country and abolish slavery. With the moral courage and fierce determination to succeed, his choices during this critical moment will change the fate of generations to come.

Title: The Social Network
Body (HTML): In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

Title: Gattaca
Body (HTML): Vincent is an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection. He is an "In-Valid" who assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation.

Title: Oceans Thirteen
Body (HTML): Danny Ocean's team of criminals are back and composing a plan more personal than ever. When ruthless casino owner Willy Bank doublecrosses Reuben Tishkoff, causing a heart attack, Danny Ocean vows that he and his team will do anything to bring down Willy Bank along with everything he's got. Even if it means asking for help from an enemy.

Title: XMen Collection
Body (HTML): This collection gathers films from the X-Men film series, based on the Marvel Comics superhero team, following a group of mutants with extraordinary abilities as they battle threats to mutant and human kind alike.

Title: Akira Kurosawa: Four Samuri Classics
Body (HTML): This Criterion Collection box set gathers four classic samurai films directed by Akira Kurosawa: Seven Samurai, The Hidden Fortress, Yojimbo, and Sanjuro.
Image Alt Text: Akira Kurosawa: Four Samuri Classics poster

Title: A Kid in King Arthur's Court
Body (HTML): A Kid in King Arthur's Court follows 14-year-old Calvin Fuller, a struggling Little Leaguer who is swept by an earthquake into medieval Camelot. Mistaken for a prophesied hero, he must help King Arthur defend his crown from the scheming Lord Belasco while overcoming his own fears. Mixing slapstick, time-travel fish-out-of-water comedy, and family-friendly adventure, it offers lighthearted fun for kids, though critics found it formulaic and dated.
Image Alt Text: A Kid in King Arthur's Court poster

Title: Beauty and the Beast
Body (HTML): Beauty and the Beast (1991) tells of Belle, a spirited young woman who becomes entwined in the fate of a cursed prince transformed into a Beast, and discovers that true beauty lies within. Blending romance, wit, and memorable songs with groundbreaking animation, it was the first animated film nominated for Best Picture. Acclaimed for its artistry, music, and heartfelt storytelling, it remains a timeless Disney classic worth seeing.

Title: Antz
Body (HTML): Antz follows Z, a neurotic worker ant yearning for individuality, who unexpectedly gets swept into adventure after crossing paths with Princess Bala. As he navigates a rigid colony system and an ambitious general’s plans, Z’s quest blends humor, social satire, and action. Praised for its sharp wit, impressive early CGI, and an all-star voice cast, it’s more adult-oriented than typical animation, offering layered jokes and themes that make it worth watching for grown-ups as well as older kids.

Title: The Aristocats
Body (HTML): The Aristocats follows a refined family of Parisian cats whose pampered life is upended when a greedy butler tries to cut them out of an inheritance. Stranded in the countryside, they team up with a street-smart alley cat for a lively journey home. Filled with jazzy tunes, colorful animation, and charming characters, this lighthearted Disney classic is a fun, heartwarming watch, though its plot is simple and familiar.

Title: Pocahontas
Body (HTML): Pocahontas (1995) tells the story of a free-spirited Native American woman whose encounter with Englishman John Smith challenges cultural divides and inspires her to follow her heart. With its lush, painterly animation, heartfelt songs like “Colors of the Wind,” and themes of harmony and understanding, it’s a visually striking and emotionally sincere Disney film. While historically inaccurate and lighter on villainy, it remains a worthwhile watch for its artistry and message.

Title: The Black Couldron
Body (HTML): The Black Cauldron is a dark fantasy adventure from Disney that follows young pig-keeper Taran, who dreams of heroism but is thrust into a perilous quest to stop the fearsome Horned King from using a magical cauldron to raise an undead army. With its atmospheric animation, eerie villain, and absence of songs, it’s an atypical and darker Disney entry. While flawed in pacing and tone, it’s a visually striking cult favorite worth seeing for fantasy fans.

Title: The Princess Bride
Body (HTML): The Princess Bride blends romance, adventure, comedy, and fantasy in a storybook tale framed as a grandfather reading to his reluctant grandson. Farmhand Westley embarks on a perilous quest to reunite with his beloved Buttercup, encountering duels, giants, clever banter, and whimsical perils. Celebrated for its charm, wit, and quotable lines, it’s a timeless classic appealing to all ages.

Title: The Goonies
Body (HTML): The Goonies follows a tight-knit group of kids in a coastal town who embark on a high-stakes treasure hunt after finding an old pirate map—a quest that could save their homes from foreclosure. Their adventure leads through underground tunnels, elaborate booby traps, and run-ins with a criminal family. Loved for its charm, energy, and camaraderie, it’s a nostalgic, fun ride that blends youthful humor with Spielberg-style adventure.

Title: Richie Rich
Body (HTML): Richie Rich follows the world’s wealthiest boy, who has everything money can buy except true friends. When a plot targets his family’s fortune and safety, he must rely on his wits, loyal staff, and newfound pals to set things right. Lighthearted and filled with imaginative gadgets, it’s a kid-centric adventure that offers charm and fun over depth, making it enjoyable family fare for younger audiences.

Title: Heavyweights
Body (HTML): Heavyweights is a 1995 Disney comedy about kids at a weight-loss summer camp whose fun is derailed when an overzealous fitness guru takes over, turning it into a strict training ground. With help from sympathetic counselors, they plot to reclaim their summer. Though a box office flop, it’s now a cult favorite for its offbeat humor, 90s charm, and Ben Stiller’s over-the-top villain, offering lighthearted fun for fans of quirky family comedies.

Title: Hunchback of Notre Dame
Body (HTML): The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996) follows Quasimodo, the kind-hearted yet isolated bell ringer of Notre Dame, who longs to explore the world and finds friendship in the fearless Esmeralda. Against the tyranny of Judge Frollo, he must choose between obedience and defending justice. With stunning animation, powerful Alan Menken music, and mature themes of prejudice, acceptance, and love, it’s one of Disney’s most dramatic and emotionally resonant films—highly worth watching.

Title: Free Willy
Body (HTML): Free Willy (1993) tells the heartfelt story of a troubled 12-year-old boy who bonds with a captive orca at a struggling amusement park and risks everything to help his new friend. Blending themes of friendship, second chances, and compassion for animals, it combines touching performances, a stirring score, and a classic feel-good formula. Praised for its warmth and uplifting message, it remains a beloved family film worth watching.

Title: Muppets from Space
Body (HTML): Muppets from Space follows Gonzo as he searches for his origins and becomes convinced he’s connected to aliens. When he’s kidnapped by a secret government agency, Kermit and the gang set out on a zany rescue mission. Packed with quirky humor, celebrity cameos, and a funky soundtrack, it offers lighthearted fun for Muppet fans, though some critics note a thinner plot and less energy than earlier films.

Title: Mulan
Body (HTML): Mulan follows a courageous young woman who disguises herself as a man to take her father’s place in the Chinese army, embarking on a journey of honor, self-discovery, and heroism. Combining stunning animation, heartfelt themes, humor, and memorable songs, the film delivers both adventure and emotional depth. Critics praise it as an empowering Disney classic that appeals to all ages, making it a must-watch.

Title: The Elm-Chanted Forest
Body (HTML): A painter who can temporarily talk to the creatures of an enchanted forest must help them stop the evil Cactus King, who's building an army of magical living weapons and machines to turn the forest into a wasteland perfect for the cacti.

Title: E.T. The Extra Terrestrial
Body (HTML): E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial follows a lonely boy, Elliott, who forms a deep bond with a gentle alien stranded on Earth and tries to help him return home while evading government capture. Blending heartfelt drama, childhood wonder, and imaginative sci-fi, Steven Spielberg’s film is praised for its emotional depth, iconic imagery, and John Williams’ unforgettable score, making it a timeless family classic worth watching for all ages.

Title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
Body (HTML): Honey, I Blew Up the Kid (1992) follows eccentric inventor Wayne Szalinski, whose latest experiment accidentally causes his toddler son to grow to monumental proportions whenever exposed to electricity. As the oversized child heads for Las Vegas, the family scrambles to reverse the process before chaos ensues. While lighter and more juvenile than its predecessor, it offers fun visual effects and harmless family comedy, making it an enjoyable, if modest, sequel.
Image Alt Text: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid poster

Title: Muppets Treasure Island
Body (HTML): Muppet Treasure Island (1996) is a musical comedy adventure where Jim Hawkins embarks on a swashbuckling treasure hunt with Kermit’s Captain Smollett, facing pirates led by the charming yet scheming Long John Silver. Blending Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic tale with the Muppets’ trademark humor, catchy songs, and colorful characters, it’s a lighthearted, family-friendly romp. Critics praise Tim Curry’s performance and the film’s fun, making it a nostalgic treat worth watching.

Title: 101 Dalmations
Body (HTML): 101 Dalmatians (1996) is a live-action remake of Disney’s animated classic, following a daring rescue mission when a fur-obsessed fashion designer kidnaps Dalmatian puppies for a lavish coat. Packed with slapstick, charming performances, and adorable canines, it’s highlighted by Glenn Close’s memorable turn as Cruella de Vil. While reviews were mixed, it remains lighthearted family fun and a nostalgic watch for fans of the original.

Title: Mrs. Doubtfire

When Daniel learns his ex needs a housekeeper, he gets the job -- disguised as a British nanny. Soon he becomes not only his children's best pal but the kind of parent he should have been from the start.

Title: Arthur
Body (HTML): Arthur is a 30-year-old child who will inherit $750 million if he complies with his family's demands and marries the woman of their choosing.

Title: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
Body (HTML): When diabolical genius Dr. Evil travels back in time to steal superspy Austin Powers's ‘mojo,’ Austin must return to the swingin' '60s himself - with the help of American agent, Felicity Shagwell - to stop the dastardly plan. Once there, Austin faces off against Dr. Evil's army of minions to try to save the world in his own unbelievably groovy way.

Title: Next Friday
Body (HTML): A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has just escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows and the suburbs will never be the same.

Title: Dirty Dancing
Body (HTML): Expecting the usual tedium that accompanies a summer in the Catskills with her family, 17-year-old Frances 'Baby' Houseman is surprised to find herself stepping into the shoes of a professional hoofer—and unexpectedly falling in love.

Title: Hellfighters
Body (HTML): The adventures of oil well fire specialist Chance Buckman (based on real-life Red Adair), who extinguishes massive fires in oil fields around the world.

Title: The Natural
Body (HTML): An unknown middle-aged batter named Roy Hobbs with a mysterious past appears out of nowhere to take a losing 1930s baseball team to the top of the league.

Title: Boys Town
Body (HTML): Devout but iron-willed Father Flanagan leads a community called Boys Town, a different sort of juvenile detention facility where, instead of being treated as underage criminals, the boys are shepherded into making themselves better people. But hard-nosed petty thief and pool shark Whitey Marsh, the impulsive and violent younger brother of an imprisoned murderer, might be too much for the good father's tough-love system.

Title: Matinee
Body (HTML): A showman introduces a small coastal town to a unique movie experience and capitalizes on the Cuban Missile crisis hysteria with a kitschy horror extravaganza combining film effects, stage props and actors in rubber suits in this salute to the B-movie.

Title: Twice Upon a Yesterday (Screener)
Body (HTML): Twice Upon a Yesterday is a 1998 romantic comedy film in which a man is given a magical second chance to undo his breakup with the woman he loves, only to find the consequences more complicated than he expected.
Tags: Floor Sale, Formatted, Romantic Comedy, VHS

Title: A Piece of the Action
Body (HTML): How does retired cop Joshua Burke (James Earl Jones) get two career criminals, Manny Durrell (Sidney Poitier) and Dave Anderson (Bill Cosby), to follow the straight and narrow? Con them into helping juvenile delinquents turn over a new leaf. But how? Burke has never been able to nail the duo, but he uses what he knows of their seedy past to blackmail them into volunteering.
Image Alt Text: A Piece of the Action (1977) poster

Title: Class Act
Body (HTML): Duncan is a genius straight A student, Blade is ajuvenile delinquent. But because of a mix up with their school records, everyone thinks each is the other one. Now, Duncan kind of likes the attention from being thought of as a real bad dude, if only the school bully would stop trying to rough him up. And Blade definitely likes being thought of as important instead of as trouble.

Title: Winners Take All
Body (HTML): Billy Robinson has become the hottest hot-rodder on the professional motorcycle-racing circuit. But when he returns in triumph to his hometown to bask in all the adulation, he also skids into some pretty rank jealousy from envious motorcycling wanna-bes. And when a local race is organized, Billy must shift gears completely and compete against his best friend, Rick, for the top prize.

Title: Things Change
Body (HTML): Jerry, a misfit Mafia henchman, is assigned the low-level job of keeping an eye on Gino, a shoe repairman fingered by the Mob to confess to a murder he didn't commit. But Gino's mistaken for a Mafia boss, and the two are suddenly catapulted to the highest levels of mobster status. Only friendship will see them through this dangerous adventure alive!

Title: The 40 Year Old Virgin
Body (HTML): Andy Stitzer has a pleasant life with a nice apartment and a job stamping invoices at an electronics store. But at age 40, there's one thing Andy hasn't done, and it's really bothering his sex-obsessed male co-workers: Andy is still a virgin. Determined to help Andy get laid, the guys make it their mission to de-virginize him. But it all seems hopeless until Andy meets small business owner Trish, a single mom.

Title: 21 Jump Street
Body (HTML): When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high school students. They trade in their guns and badges for backpacks, and set out to shut down a dangerous drug ring. But, as time goes on, Schmidt and Jenko discover that high school is nothing like it was just a few years earlier -- and, what's more, they must again confront the teenage terror and anxiety they thought they had left behind.

Title: Beauty and the Beast (Live Action)
Body (HTML): Beauty and the Beast is a 2017 American musical romantic fantasy film, a live-action remake of Disney's 1991 animated film. It follows Belle, a young woman held captive in an enchanted castle by a prince cursed to live as a beast.

Title: Beetlejuice
Body (HTML): A newly dead New England couple seeks help from a deranged demon exorcist to scare an affluent New York family out of their home.

Title: Beastly
Body (HTML): A modern-day take on the "Beauty and the Beast" tale where a New York teen is transformed into a hideous monster in order to find true love.

Title: Battleship
Body (HTML): When mankind beams a radio signal into space, a reply comes from ‘Planet G’, in the form of several alien crafts that splash down in the waters off Hawaii. Lieutenant Alex Hopper is a weapons officer assigned to the USS John Paul Jones, part of an international naval coalition which becomes the world's last hope for survival as they engage the hostile alien force of unimaginable strength. While taking on the invaders, Hopper must also try to live up to the potential that his brother, and his fiancée's father—an Admiral—expect of him.

Title: Battman V Superman: Dawn of Justice
Body (HTML): Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice is a 2016 American superhero film directed by Zack Snyder, based on DC Comics characters. Batman perceives Superman as a threat to humanity, while other forces conspire to bring about a battle between the two heroes.
Image Alt Text: Battman V Superman: Dawn of Justice poster

Body (HTML): Dr. Adrian Helmsley, part of a worldwide geophysical team investigating the effect on the earth of radiation from unprecedented solar storms, learns that the earth's core is heating up. He warns U.S. President Thomas Wilson that the crust of the earth is becoming unstable and that without proper preparations for saving a fraction of the world's population, the entire race is doomed. Meanwhile, writer Jackson Curtis stumbles on the same information. While the world's leaders race to build "arks" to escape the impending cataclysm, Curtis struggles to find a way to save his family. Meanwhile, volcanic eruptions and earthquakes of unprecedented strength wreak havoc around the world.

Title: American Sniper
Body (HTML): U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle takes his sole mission—protect his comrades—to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.

Title: American Pie Presents: The Book of Love
Body (HTML): Ten years after the first American Pie movie, three new hapless virgins discover the Bible hidden in the school library at East Great Falls High. Unfortunately for them, the book is ruined, and with incomplete advice, the Bible leads them on a hilarious journey to lose their virginity.
Image Alt Text: American Pie Presents: The Book of Love (2009) poster

Title: Age of the Dragons
Body (HTML): Age of the Dragons is an adaptation of Herman Melville's classic novel Moby Dick. Set in a medieval realm where Captain Ahab and crew hunt dragons for the vitriol that powers their world, Ishmael, a charismatic harpooner and his friend Queequeg join their quest. Ahab's adopted daughter Rachel, beautiful and tough, runs the hunting vessel. Ahab's obsession to seek revenge on a great White Dragon that slaughtered his family when he was young and left his body scarred and mauled, drives the crew deeper into the heart of darkness. In the White Dragon's lair Ahab's secrets are revealed and Rachel must choose between following him on his dark quest or escaping to a new life with Ishmael.

Title: Annihilation
Body (HTML): A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.

Title: Abominable
Body (HTML): A group of misfits encounter a young Yeti named Everest, and they set off to reunite the magical creature with his family on the mountain of his namesake.

Title: One Direction: This is Us
Body (HTML): "One Direction: This Is Us" is a captivating and intimate all-access look at life on the road for the global music phenomenon. Weaved with stunning live concert footage, this inspiring feature film tells the remarkable story of Niall, Zayn, Liam, Harry and Louis' meteoric rise to fame, from their humble hometown beginnings and competing on the X-Factor, to conquering the world and performing at London’s famed O2 Arena. Hear it from the boys themselves and see through their own eyes what it's really like to be One Direction.
Image Alt Text: One Direction: This is Us (2013) poster

Title: Angels & Demons
Body (HTML): Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon is recruited by the Vatican to investigate the apparent return of the Illuminati – a secret, underground organization – after four cardinals are kidnapped on the night of the papal conclave.

Title: Doomsday Prophecy
Body (HTML): With the government agents on their trail, journalist Eric Fox and archaeologist Brook Calvin race against time to save the world after they find an artefact that predicts an impending doomsday.

Title: Doom
Body (HTML): A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm, who is related to team member Reaper, informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

Title: Big Hero 6
Body (HTML): A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

Title: Aeon Flux
Body (HTML): 400 years into the future, disease has wiped out the majority of the world's population, except one walled city, Bregna, ruled by a congress of scientists. When Æon Flux, the top operative in the underground 'Monican' rebellion, is sent on a mission to kill a government leader, she uncovers a world of secrets.

Title: The Adjustment Bureau
Body (HTML): A man glimpses the future Fate has planned for him – and chooses to fight for his own destiny. Battling the powerful Adjustment Bureau across, under and through the streets of New York, he risks his destined greatness to be with the only woman he's ever loved.

Title: Alice Through the Looking Glass / Alice in Wonderland
Tags: Blu-Ray, Floor Sale, Formatted, Kids & Family

Title: Alexander Revisted: The Final Cut
Body (HTML): Alexander is a 2004 epic historical drama directed by Oliver Stone, based on the life of Alexander the Great, the ancient Macedonian king who conquered much of the known world. Colin Farrell stars in the title role.

Title: Alexande: Directors Cut

Title: Duets
Body (HTML): Duets is a road-trip comedy which revolves around the little known world of karaoke and the whimsical characters who inhabit it. All roads lead to Omaha, site of a national karaoke competition where this motley group of singers and stars come together for a blow-out sing-off.

Title: Dumbo (Tim Burton)

Body (HTML): On Aug. 21, 2015, the world watches in stunned silence as the media reports a thwarted terrorist attack on a train that's bound for Paris -- an attempt prevented by three young Americans traveling together through Europe. The heroic and courageous actions of Anthony Sadler, Alek Skarlatos and Spencer Stone help to save the lives of more than 500 passengers on board.
A story very loosely based the 480 B.C. Battle of Thermopylae, where the King of Sparta led his army against the advancing Persians.

Title: 101 Dalmations
Body (HTML): Get ready for a howling good time as an all new assortment of irresistible animal heroes are unleashed in this great family tail! In an unlikely alliance, the outrageous Waddlesworth - a parrot who thinks he's a Rottweiler - teams up with Oddball - an un-marked Dalmatian puppy eager to earn her spots! Together they embark on a laugh-packed quest to outwit the ever-scheming Cruella De Vil.
Tags: Blu-Ray, Floor Sale, Formatted, Kids & Family

Title: Air Force One / In the Line of Fire

Title: Andrea Bocelli
Body (HTML): For the first time, Andrea Bocelli presents a full length spanish album that features no classical influences. Spanish guitars flourish, accordions and harmonicas provide charming melodies, traditional Latin percussion insistently keeps the tempo. Sometimes Andrea shares the spotlight with just a grand piano. Beautiful orchestras remain, but for 'Amor' Andrea stylistically exchanges the grandeur of a 19th century European opera house for the romance of a 20th century Hollywood sound studio. Amor features Latin American classics including: 'Besame Mucho' (the song was a million selling US hit for Jimmy Dorsey & His Orchestra in 1941). Universal. 2006.

Title: African Cats
Body (HTML): African Cats captures the real-life love, humor and determination of the majestic kings of the savanna. The story features Mara, an endearing lion cub who strives to grow up with her mother’s strength, spirit and wisdom; Sita, a fearless cheetah and single mother of five mischievous newborns; and Fang, a proud leader of the pride who must defend his family from a once banished lion.

Body (HTML): Bond 50: The Complete 22 Film Collection gathers 22 James Bond spy films spanning Sean Connery through Daniel Craig.

Title: Earth to Echo

Convinced something bigger is going on, they go to their parents and the authorities. The three embark on a secret adventure to crack the code and follow it to its source, and discover a mysterious being from another world who desperately needs their help. The journey that follows will change all their lives forever.
Tags: Blu-Ray, Floor Sale, Formatted, Kids & Family

Body (HTML): A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".

Title: Earth's Final Hours
Body (HTML): After dense matter from an imploded white hole hits Earth, the planet's rotation is devastated. A group of government agents must locate a lost satellite network that is the world's only hope for survival.

Title: Earth: One Amazing Day
Body (HTML): An astonishing journey revealing the awesome power of the natural world. Over the course of one single day, we track the sun from the highest mountains to the remotest islands to exotic jungles.

Title: Eight Below
Body (HTML): In the Antarctic, after an expedition with Dr. Davis McClaren, the sled dog trainer Jerry Shepherd has to leave the polar base with his colleagues due to the proximity of a heavy snow storm. He ties his dogs to be rescued after, but the mission is called-off and the dogs are left alone at their own fortune. For six months, Jerry tries to find a sponsor for a rescue mission.

Title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
Body (HTML): Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer. Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.
Image Alt Text: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008) poster

Title: Bee Movie
Body (HTML): Barry B. Benson, a recent college graduate who wants more out of his life than making honey, decides to sue the human race after learning about the exploitation of bees at the hands of mankind. What will happen next?

Title: Beowulf & Grendel
Body (HTML): The blood-soaked tale of a Norse warrior's battle against the great and murderous troll, Grendel. Heads will roll. Out of allegiance to the King Hrothgar, the much respected Lord of the Danes, Beowulf leads a troop of warriors across the sea to rid a village of the marauding monster.

Title: 15 Minutes
Body (HTML): When Eastern European criminals Oleg and Emil come to New York City to pick up their share of a heist score, Oleg steals a video camera and starts filming their activities, both legal and illegal. When they learn how the American media circus can make a remorseless killer look like the victim and make them rich, they target media-savvy NYPD Homicide Detective Eddie Flemming and media-naive FDNY Fire Marshal Jordy Warsaw, the cops investigating their murder and torching of their former criminal partner, filming everything to sell to the local tabloid TV show "Top Story."

Title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua 2
Body (HTML): Puppy mayhem turns the lives of newlywed Chihuahua parents Papi and Chloe upside down when their rambunctious, mischievous puppies present one challenge after another. But when their human owners end up in trouble, the tiny pups will stop at nothing to save them - because in good times and hard times, the family always sticks together. So Papi, Chloe and the puppies embark on a heroic adventure, proving once again that big heroes come in small packages.
Tags: DVD, Floor Sale, Formatted, Kids & Family

Title: Big Miracle
Body (HTML): A small-town news reporter and a Greenpeace volunteer enlist the help of rival superpowers to save three majestic gray whales trapped under the ice of the Arctic Circle.

Title: After Earth
Body (HTML): One thousand years after cataclysmic events forced humanity's escape from Earth, Nova Prime has become mankind's new home. Legendary General Cypher Raige returns from an extended tour of duty to his estranged family, ready to be a father to his 13-year-old son, Kitai. When an asteroid storm damages Cypher and Kitai's craft, they crash-land on a now unfamiliar and dangerous Earth. As his father lies dying in the cockpit, Kitai must trek across the hostile terrain to recover their rescue beacon. His whole life, Kitai has wanted nothing more than to be a soldier like his father. Today, he gets his chance.

Title: Amazing Grace
Body (HTML): The true story of William Wilberforce and his courageous quest to end the British slave trade. Along the way, Wilberforce meets intense opposition, but his minister urges him to see the cause through.

Title: Alvin and the Chipmunks

Title: Apocolypto
Body (HTML): Apocalypto is a 2006 epic historical action-adventure film directed by Mel Gibson, following a young Maya man's fight for survival.

Title: Ant Man and the Wasp
Body (HTML): Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

Title: Ant Man
Body (HTML): Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

Title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
Body (HTML): President Lincoln's mother is killed by a supernatural creature, which fuels his passion to crush vampires and their slave-owning helpers.

Tags: Blu-Ray, Floor Sale, Formatted, Kids & Family

Title: 10,000 BC
Body (HTML): A prehistoric epic that follows a young mammoth hunter's journey through uncharted territory to secure the future of his tribe.

Title: Dracula: The Dark Prince
Body (HTML): In his search for the Lightbringer, Dracula crosses paths with a beautiful crusader named Alina who bears a remarkable resemblance to his murdered bride. One look at her and Dracula is immediately smitten. Could Alina be the reincarnation of his long-dead love? Dracula has Alina kidnapped and brought to his castle where the Beast must now try to win his Beauty's heart.

Title: Dorian Gray
Body (HTML): London, England. Dorian Gray is a young man who somehow keeps his beauty eternally, while a mysterious portrait of himself gradually reveals his moral decay.

Title: The Duchess
Body (HTML): A chronicle of the life of 18th century aristocrat Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire, who was reviled for her extravagant political and personal life.
